messages:
alex_ts: Quick trouble report — sample app in monorepo fails to build on Vercel Edge: "Could not resolve '@redwood/sdk'". Works if I cd into packages/sdk and run locally. Using pnpm workspace.

sara_devex: This rings a bell. Often exports map + pnpm symlink + edge bundler mismatch. What does package.json exports look like?

ravi_eng: If exports only points to dist entrypoints (import/require) without exposing package.json or subpaths, some bundlers won't find it. Also TS may not find types from hoisted layout.

alex_ts: current: {"name":"@redwood/sdk","exports":{"import":"./dist/index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs"},"types":"dist/index.d.ts"} — minimal.

sara_devex: Try adding: "./package.json": "./package.json" and a conditional edge import: {"import": {"edge":"./dist/edge.mjs","default":"./dist/index.mjs"}}. Also consider "./*": "./dist/*" for subpaths.

ravi_eng: For types fix: ensure "types":"dist/index.d.ts" and optionally typesVersions or a root d.ts proxy so TS server resolves in workspace. Short-term hack: postinstall script that writes index.d.mjs re-export to root for bundlers.

sara_devex: FYI edge bundlers can drop side-effect modules. If auth token refresh relies on a patch module, import it at top of the edge entry or list it in sideEffects. We had a case where tokens stopped refreshing only on edge previews because of this.

build-bot: CI suggestion: add repo-level smoke step: `pnpm --filter apps/sample build` to catch these packaging/regression issues early.

alex_ts: Perfect, thanks. I'll open a small PR with package.json tweaks (package.json export + edge conditional) and a sample app CI smoke build.
